Hot Cheesy Bacon Party Dip
By: Wendi Spraker
Published: Tuesday, December 30, 2014 - 1:23pm

Ingredients




8 slices of bacon - cooked crispy and crumbled
1 8oz package of cream cheese
1c mayo
1 c cheddar cheese(sharp is best, mild is fine too)
2 Roma tomatoes – seeds and inner goop removed – only use the outside meat
1 small bundle of green onions – finely chopped
2 Tbs minced garlic

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 2 Mix together cream cheese, cheddar, mayo tomatoes, onions, garlic and bacon in a bowl. 3 Put in an oven safe dish and bake for 20 mins on 350 or until bubbly and browning on top.

About

YOU be the party with Hot Cheesy Bacon Party Dip!  So easy and YUMMY!
